entities.name: Trokair
entities.description: An Icatian city on Sarpadia led by mayor Lydia Wynforth, destroyed by goblin and orc forces.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: The nation of which Trokair was a city.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: A group that broke away from Icatia after Trokair's destruction.

entities.name: Flagstones of Trokair
entities.description: Flagstones that stood for millennia after the city's destruction.

events.summary: The citizens and troops of Trokair hold out against goblin and orc forces before the city is destroyed.
events.quote: The citizens and troops of Trokair long held out against the goblin and orc forces before being destroyed.

events.summary: The city's destruction causes the Farrelites to break away from Icatia.
events.quote: The city's destruction caused the Farrelites to break away from Icatia as a whole.

relations.quote: Trokair was an Icatian city led by mayor Lydia Wynforth
